manifest_binding: MANIFEST.sha256 contains every package path and content hash except itself; SOURCE_ALLOWLIST.txt contains the exact payload paths; payload_manifest_sha256 is sha256 of the lexicographically sorted, newline-terminated '<sha256>  <path>' lines of the payload; prior_deployment_content_aggregate_sha256 is that same value computed over the app tree of release-2026.08.17-bold-run-in-wrap, the deployment this package supersedes (the 2026.08.17 deployment shipped without a reinstall package; the last packaged version was 2026.08.13)
excluded_classes: production uploads, outputs, progress, tasks, caches, logs and installer state
fonts, audit evidence, backups and Git metadata
